description: This Java class 'FrameImage' provides functionalities for uploading, combining, previewing, and managing frame images within an image management module of an e-commerce platform. It handles image processing, file operations, and service interactions related to product image frames.

classes.name: FrameImage
classes.description: A utility class for managing product frame images, including uploading, combining, previewing, and associating images with products in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addImageFrame
methods.description: Handles the process of adding a frame to a product image, including image resizing, combining, creating content and data resources, and establishing associations.

methods.name: combineBufferedImage
methods.description: Combines two images into a single BufferedImage with transparency and centering.

methods.name: uploadFrame
methods.description: Handles uploading a new frame image, saving it to the server, creating data resources and content entries, and managing session attributes.

methods.name: previewFrameImage
methods.description: Generates a preview image by overlaying a frame onto a product image, saving the result temporarily for display.

methods.name: chooseFrameImage
methods.description: Selects an existing frame image and sets session attributes for further processing.

methods.name: deleteFrameImage
methods.description: Deletes the temporary preview image file.
